data.narrative:
Aepnus Technology is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Lukas Hackl and Bilen Akuzum that has raised $10.6M to date. The Climate & Energy sector comprises a universe of 8 private peers and 1 public comparable (Lonza Group, ticker LNZA), though narrower peer filtering by stage and valuation tier did not yield sufficient datapoints for reliable peer-median analysis.

The valuation assessment relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression to the $10.6M raised as a proxy base value. This produces an implied valuation of $26.5M. No additional triangulation methods were applicable; peer-median analysis was excluded due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the Climate & Energy sector to support a statistically robust estimate.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $23M to $30M, with a median point of $26M. This range reflects ±15% variance around the stage-progression midpoint, acknowledging the single-method foundation. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to sector peers, the absence of narrower-stage comparable data, and the early maturity profile typical of Seed-stage frontier technology companies. Validation through additional financing activity or refined peer classification would strengthen conviction in this estimate.
